title: Qi-Edged Brush Cutting
summary: Teaches a Senior student to run qi along the machete's edge and cut through straps and guards.

title: A Treatise on the Returning Machete Stroke
summary: Builds the out-and-back stroke of the machete so that each pass renews its qi at the turn.

title: Methods of the Binding Spine
summary: Uses the blunt back of the machete with qi behind it to pin and twist an opponent's weapon.

title: Handbook of Thicket Fighting
summary: A handbook for cutting and slipping through tangled ground where a longer blade would catch.

title: The Weighted Wrist and Qi Drill-Book
summary: A long drill-book that trains the wrist to carry qi through the machete's heavy strokes without strain.

title: Canon of Close-Quarters Brush Blade
summary: Covers the short cuts and hilt strikes of the machete when the fight is too tight for a full swing.

title: A Treatise on Bow-Cut and Sweep Chains
summary: Chains the curved bow cut into low sweeps so one stroke flows into the next with qi at each join.

title: The Plain Man's Guide to Qi Lopping
summary: A plain guide that gives a working fighter a few reliable qi-fed lopping cuts and honest guards.
